acceptanceCriteria: Both files use Go escape sequences with byte-identical runtime strings; affected tests pass; a scan of tracked *.go finds no literal bidi/zero-width code points.
body: Found 2026-10-16 by Codex review on V1-0414 (PR #983): integrations/testfixture/main.go:192 contains literal U+2028, U+202E, U+200B and internal/tasks/ticket/ticket_test.go:100 contains literal U+200E inside Go string literals. Neither is a governing file, but literal invisible characters in source hide intent from reviewers. Expected: Go escape sequences.
title: Literal invisible Unicode characters in tracked Go sources (integrations/testfixture/main.go:192, internal/tasks/ticket/ticket_test.go:100)
